stem:
The lengths, $X$cm, of a sample of 100 insects of a certain type were summarised as follows.

$$n = 100 \qquad \sum x = 36.8 \qquad \sum x^2 = 17.34$$

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Calculate unbiased estimates for the population mean and variance of $X$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: State a necessary condition for the estimates found in part **(a)** to be reliable.
